title: 第十九章 刺客第二十章 鹬蚌相争
content_zh:
然后他转过头来，琉璃色的双瞳倒映出刺客的假面。
刺客登时一个激灵，后撤半步稳住，
“前，前辈恕罪！在下只是路过此地，不知前辈在此清修，在下这就离开！”
“……”
铁蛋瞅瞅他……倒也没瞅他，只瞅着对方身后的乌鸦。
现在精炁不足，妖丹可是大补之物……
“咦！”
刺客大惊！这魔头竟盯着他！凝聚炁剑，恐怕是不想善了了！
此时他分明感到对方冲天杀意，已经锁定己身！
再联想到魔教那些可止小儿夜啼的传闻！刺客心头一片冰凉！
万万想不到啊！这回真是夜路走多了，给他撞着了鬼！
不过是听小姐吩咐，找个夜黑风高的地方杀人，居然碰到这么个老魔现世，刺客实是骇得肝胆乱颤，牙关都在打架！
要逃吗？不！已经来不及了！
传闻那血神子大法世间少有！最出名就是一套遁法天下无敌！来如光电，去若飞星！
而他武炼入道，轻身功夫也就在草上飞一飞，绝没有那些魔道修士，飞天遁地那般本事！
但一世辛苦修行，替史家做了多少丧尽天良的坏事，才能有今日境界！要他束手待毙，也绝无可能口牙！
于是刺客也咬紧牙关，在那一对琉璃色的非人瞳目前，强撑气场，怒呵出声，给自己打气！
“哼！魔头！真当我怕了你么！莫以为我看不出！你现在的身形动作，不过区区筑基光景，明显尚未恢复实力，又有甚么了不起的！”
铁蛋，“……”
“呵啊！”

刺客大吼一声，全力爆气！炸飞身上夜行衣，露出一身铁键钢肌！
“而今你已手杀二兽，炁血耗尽！而我已炼成神罡霸体！又有金钟罩神功护身！刀枪不入！何惧之有哉！
呀呀呀呀啊呵——！看招！十七重罡拳！给我开口牙！！！”
“轰！”
当下！刺客使出毕生功力！以《罡拳秘要》催动全身炁血！一身青筋炸起！把全身肌肉充得如铁似钢！身型都再壮大一倍！
“将你轰杀至渣口牙！”
“砰！”
刺客蓄力冲刺！以十七重罡拳催动！假面刺客一个弹射起步，踏碎砖石，暴跳出来！双手鬼爪乱舞！罡风大作！功力爆轰！打出鬼魅般骇人爪印！
誓要毕生功力，赌在这一击之上！将此血魔毙于爪下！
铁蛋简直无语。
“……”
真的，完全不明白这人什么逻辑。
刚才不是还说不关他事么，突然疯了一样打过来干嘛？
不过对方到底是历战的高手，眼光却也毒辣。
铁蛋这次虽说是做了个鱼吐泡泡的怪梦，不知得的什么莫名仙缘，如今涅槃重生，脱胎换骨。但身体素质提升，似乎也没有那妖化，罡拳一般的巨大。
刚才试刺了狐狸一剑，身法劲道，确实也就和筑基期修士类似，瞧着似乎是突破筑基了，但又和剑宗算传筑基之法天差地别，不尽相同，暂时又没有合适的筑基期道法内功加持，铁蛋也瞧不出来，现在自己算什么状态。
但总归，以筑基之力，肯定根本避不开对方这样神罡霸体，全力扑来，舍身拼命的正面轰击！
content_en:
Then he turned his head, his glazed eyes reflecting the assassin's mask.
The assassin was immediately startled and took half a step back to stabilize himself.
"Senior, please forgive me! I'm just passing by here. I didn't know that I'm here to do some spiritual cultivation, so I'll leave now!"
"..."
Tiedan looked at him...but not at him, only looking at the crow behind him.
Now that the energy is insufficient, the demon pill is a great supplement...
"Eh!"
The assassin was shocked! This devil was staring at him! Condensing Qi Sword, I’m afraid I don’t want to be good anymore!
At this time, he clearly felt that the other party had murderous intent and had locked onto him!
Then think of the rumors from the Demon Cult that it can stop children from crying at night! The assassin's heart felt cold!
Never imagined! This time I really walked a lot at night, and he got bumped into a ghost!
He just followed the young lady's instructions and found a dark and windy place to kill people. To meet such an old demon in this world, the assassin was so frightened that his liver and gallbladder trembled, and his teeth were chattering!
Want to escape? No! It's too late!
It is rumored that the Blood God Son's magic is rare in the world! The most famous one is a set of escape techniques that are invincible in the world! Comes like light and electricity, goes like flying stars!
And when he entered the Tao through martial arts, he could only fly on the grass with his lightness skills. He was definitely not as capable as those demonic monks who could fly into the sky and escape from the earth!
But I have practiced hard throughout my life and done many unscrupulous bad things for the historian, so that I can reach where I am today! If you want him to sit back and wait for death, there is absolutely no way he can keep his mouth shut!
So the assassin also gritted his teeth, and in front of those pair of glazed inhuman eyes, he forced his aura and roared angrily to cheer himself up!
"Hmph! Devil! Do you really think I'm afraid of you! Don't think I can't see it! Your current body movements are just a mere foundation building. It's obvious that you haven't recovered your strength yet, so what's so great about it!"
Tiedan, "..."
"Haha!"
The assassin roared and exploded with all his strength! The night clothes were blown off, revealing a body of iron-clad steel!
"Now you have killed two beasts with your hands, and your energy blood has been exhausted! And I have refined the body of Shen Gang Hegemon! And I have the golden bell cover to protect me! I am invulnerable! What's the need to fear!
Ahhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh! Watch the move! Seventeen-fold Gang Fist! Open your teeth! ! ! "
"Boom!"
Now! The assassin used his lifelong skills! Use "Secrets of Gangquan" to activate the blood all over your body! Veins all over his body exploded! Make your whole body muscles as strong as iron! The body size has doubled again!
"Kill you to death!"
"Bang!"
The assassin charges up and sprints! Use the seventeen-fold Gang Fist to activate! The Masked Assassin launches himself into the air, crushes the bricks and rocks, and jumps out! The ghost claws on both hands are dancing wildly! The strong wind is blowing! Explosive power! Make ghostly and terrifying claw marks!
I vowed to devote my whole life to this attack! Kill this blood demon at your claws!
Tiedan was speechless.
"..."
Really, I don’t understand this person’s logic at all.
Didn't you just say it was none of his business? Why are you calling me like crazy all of a sudden?
But after all, the opponent is a seasoned master, but he also has a vicious vision.
Although Tiedan had a strange dream about fish spitting bubbles this time, he had some inexplicable fate, and now he has been reborn and reborn. But the improvement in physical fitness does not seem to be as huge as that of demonization and Gang Fist.
I just tried stabbing the fox with a sword, and the strength of my movement is indeed similar to that of a monk in the foundation building stage. It seems to have broken through the foundation building, but it is very different from the foundation building method passed down by the Sword Sect. For the time being, there is no suitable internal power blessing of the foundation building stage Taoist technique. Tiedan can't tell what kind of state he is in now.
But in the end, with the power of foundation building, it is definitely impossible to avoid the opponent with such a divine power. He will rush at him with all his strength and risk his life for a frontal bombardment!
